title: SCICEVPR: Stable Cross-Image Correlation Enhanced Model for Visual Place Recognition
core_idea: Introduce SCICEVPR, a VPR model that leverages multi-layer outputs of the DINOv2 backbone via a multi-layer feature fusion module and distills invariant cross-image correlations within a batch into a self-enhanced encoder, aiming to produce discriminative and stable global descriptors for robust image-based localization.
tldr: A VPR method that fuses multi-layer DINOv2 features and distills stable cross-image correlations into an encoder to generate robust global descriptors.
